text: Economy fares include 15 kg check-in and 7 kg cabin baggage on most carriers; extra kilos can be added at booking.
Bookings can be cancelled free of charge within 24 hours of purchase; after that the airline or hotel cancellation policy applies.
Eligible refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days.
Date changes carry a fixed change fee of Rs 2,500 plus any fare difference, subject to availability.
Payments are processed securely through Stripe or Razorpay; card details are never stored by the voice agent.
Carry a passport valid for at least six months and check visa requirements for your destination before travel.
